decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk builds directly on the firm's office furniture knowledge, and post-pandemic demand for flexible workplaces lets management read the market signals and keep refining the system in-house.
The chair family sits at the core of the firm's craftsmanship and upholstery expertise, so feedback is easy to absorb and the line can be extended rather than withdrawn.

The carpet floor cushions use the firm's material and upholstery skills, but they are a niche accessory whose sister rug collection was already dropped, so the firm weakly keeps them while watching for trimming.
The high standing table closely matches the firm's existing conference and office tables, so it costs little to maintain and fits the shift toward adaptable workplace interiors.
